literal.prompt: Какой национальный парк охраняет атлантическое побережье острова Маунт-Дезерт?

literalGroups.primaryGround: NPS Acadia Nature identifies Acadia National Park and says it preserves land along the Maine coast and protects coastline on Mount Desert Island. The page says the park is on the Atlantic flyway (not a claim that substitutes for the coastal facts). NPS page titles identify all choices: Zion output0 L2/L20; Great Smoky article L25–26; Acadia page L2/L20; Joshua Tree page L2/L20. Acadia alone matches the question’s park/island/coast relation.

literalGroups.literal: Это Акадия. Его ландшафт сочетает скалистые бухты и покрытые лесом горы.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NPS Acadia page describes rocky Maine coastline, mountains and forests; the explanation names Acadia and summarizes those supported landscape features.

literalGroups.literal: Зайон — парк Юты, где река Вирджин прорезает узкий каньон со стенами около 300 метров высотой.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NPS says The Narrows is the narrowest section of Zion Canyon, with 1000-foot walls, and describes travel through the Virgin River. 1000 feet converts to about 305 metres, rounded to 300. This avoids relying on an uncaptured sandstone claim.

literalGroups.literal: Грейт-Смоки-Маунтинс — парк Аппалачей на границе Теннесси и Северной Каролины.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NPS says Great Smoky Mountains lies in the Appalachian range at the Tennessee–North Carolina border. This is an additional own-option fact beyond the Mount Desert/Acadia clue.
literalGroups.locator: Smokies article L26; corroboration in contacts page in retained output1 L23

literalGroups.literal: Акадия — парк штата Мэн с гранитными горами, лесами и скалистым побережьем.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NPS describes Acadia’s granite mountains and cliffs, forests, and rocky Maine coast. The revised note preserves useful own-option details but removes the unsupported Cadillac claim.

literalGroups.literal: Джошуа-Три — калифорнийский парк на стыке пустынь Мохаве и Колорадо.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NPS locates both the Colorado and Mojave Deserts within Joshua Tree National Park in different portions of the park; it is in California.
